attrs.purpose: Environment variable configuration with in-code defaults for local development and tests.
Importlib-callable service entry point exposing run() and health().
attrs.security_invariant: Every code path that returns actions passes through is_action_permitted.

attrs.failure_mode: FileNotFoundError leaves registry None and health reports unhealthy.
Embedding failures disable semantic search without crashing startup.

attrs.returns: status error envelope with code, message, stage, details

attrs.contract: Accept caller capability_set directly or reject unresolved agent_class_id/session context.

attrs.purpose: Collect ActionContracts from registry, optionally scoped by resource_type.
attrs.error_path: Missing actions during lookup are skipped.

attrs.ordering: candidate collection, semantic rank, capability filter, action_family filter, truncate, response

attrs.contract: run(query, capability_set, session_context) returns _ok/_error dict and never raises.
Reports healthy, degraded, or unhealthy catalog state plus semantic flag and uptime.

attrs.purpose: Embedding model loader, in-memory vector store, and similarity ranking for ActionContract descriptions.

attrs.failure_mode: Catches any exception, clears model, sets enabled false, logs warning.

attrs.purpose: Precompute unit-normalized embeddings keyed by resource_type/action_name.

attrs.contract: Sort candidates by descending cosine similarity and exclude candidates below threshold.

attrs.purpose: Return cosine similarity for task_context/action, or None if disabled or encoding fails.

attrs.contract: Return unit-length vector, or unchanged vector when norm is zero.

attrs.purpose: Validate service health at startup, log summary, exit 1 when unhealthy.

attrs.rationale: Prevents token explosion from loading full action catalogs while preserving governed, advisory discovery.
ContractRegistry is in-memory only; manifests on disk let catalogs survive restarts and be edited by humans.
Structured filters cannot answer natural-language task descriptions; embedding descriptions enables semantic matching.
Expose discovery without HTTP, gRPC, or subprocess piping.

attrs.rule: An agent MUST NOT discover actions it cannot admit.
attrs.rationale: Prevents implicit privilege leakage and supports zero-trust multi-tenant capability masking.

attrs.rule: Discovery of an action does not guarantee admission and response carries no authoritative_for_mutation field.

attrs.priority_scheme: P0 blocks all downstream work, P1 blocks release, P2 should ship, P3 nice to have.

attrs.rationale: Transforms agent tooling from a hardcoded list into a dynamic, zero-trust App Store governed by cryptographic rules.

attrs.audience: New AI Developer assigned to build ForgeAtlas

attrs.purpose: Pinned Python dependencies for reproducible Docker builds.

attrs.covers: Happy path, capability filtering, trust tier filtering, missing capability context, invalid query, health, importlib callability.
Model loading, embed_catalog, similarity ranking, run() semantic integration, graceful degradation, security invariant.
ForgeWorks importlib pattern, CONCORD v0.4 response shape, action family reachability.

attrs.pattern: spec_from_file_location, module_from_spec, exec_module, direct run()/health() calls

edges.evidence: config.py defines CATALOG_PATH from FORGE_ATLAS_CATALOG_PATH with action_catalogs default.
config.py defines DEFAULT_SESSION_ID from FORGE_ATLAS_DEFAULT_SESSION_ID.
config.py defines DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS from FORGE_ATLAS_DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS.
config.py defines SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD from ACTION_DISCOVERY_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD.
config.py defines EMBEDDING_MODEL from FORGE_ATLAS_EMBEDDING_MODEL.
run.py startup constructs CatalogLoader(config.CATALOG_PATH).
run.py creates SemanticSearch(config.EMBEDDING_MODEL).
run.py calls _semantic.load_model() at module startup.
run.py calls _semantic.embed_catalog(_registry) when semantic search is enabled and registry loaded.
_resolve_capability_set calls _deserialise_capability_set when capability_set is supplied.
_resolve_capability_set returns _error for invalid capability_set, agent_class_id, or missing context.
_deserialise_query uses config.DEFAULT_SESSION_ID when session_id is absent.
_deserialise_query uses config.DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS when max_results is absent.
_collect_candidates reads the module-level _registry populated by CatalogLoader at startup.
_run_semantic starts by calling _collect_candidates(discovery_query.resource_type).
_run_semantic calls _semantic.rank_by_similarity(task_context, candidates, threshold=...).
_run_semantic passes config.SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD into rank_by_similarity and filtered_by.
_run_semantic filters ranked actions with is_action_permitted before returning summaries.
_run_semantic serializes summaries via [_summary_to_dict(s) for s in summaries].
_run_semantic computes top_score using _semantic.similarity_score for recommendations.
_run_semantic returns _ok(payload).
run() returns _error for catalog empty, invalid query, and discovery exceptions.
run() calls _deserialise_query(query) inside query parsing.
run() calls _resolve_capability_set(capability_set, session_context).
run() routes to _run_semantic when discovery_query.task_context and _semantic.enabled.
run() serializes structured response.available_actions with _summary_to_dict.
run.py docstring and structured route call execute_discovery with capability_set and agent_trust_tier.
run() payload omits authoritative_for_mutation and returns recommendations as advisory metadata.
health() reports _semantic.enabled, which is established by startup embedding/model load.
health() derives catalog_loaded, contracts_registered, failures, and catalog_version from startup loader/registry state.
load_model sets self._model and self.enabled based on SentenceTransformer initialization.
embed_catalog stores _normalise(emb) for each action description.
rank_by_similarity normalizes query and on-demand action embeddings.
similarity_score normalizes query and action embeddings before dot product.
semantic_search.py uses sentence_transformers and numpy; requirements.txt pins sentence-transformers, numpy, torch, and transformer stack.
__main__.py imports health and calls h = health().
__main__.py exits 1 when health status is unhealthy due to no contracts or failures.

Core Spec §4 defines the Semantic Search Layer.
Core Spec §5 defines the Service Wrapper Layer and transport pattern.
Core Spec §7 says ActionDiscovery MUST filter results by session AgentClass and CapabilitySet.
Core Spec §7 says responses are advisory and must carry no authoritative_for_mutation field.
semantic_search.py class lifecycle matches Core Spec semantic layer design: load model, embed catalog, rank task_context.
Core Spec §5.1 specifies run(query, capability_set, session_context); run.py exposes that function.
Core Spec §6.4 specifies health() with catalog and semantic status; run.py implements health().
Implementation Plan Phase 1 is Catalog Persistence Layer.
Implementation Plan Phase 2 is Service Wrapper.
Implementation Plan Phase 3 is Semantic Search Layer.
